name: twist
description: Rods under tension twisted past buckling, against Greenhill's critical twist.
notes: Six rods under tension are each twisted to a fraction of the twist at which a straight rod buckles, from 0.96 to 1.06, and held. Rods past the threshold bow out and grow; the ones below stay straight. The critical twist is fitted from how fast the growing rods grow. MuJoCo cannot run it: its clamps give way under this much twist.

parameters.name: tension
parameters.description: Dimensionless tension T L^2 / B. More tension needs more twist to buckle the rod, which the reference accounts for.
